name: Bó hoa bất ngờ
notes: A surprise bouquet in a flower shop's garden (KayKit Adventurers, CC0: the Barbarian in his bear hat and cape, weapons and mug dropped, and the Mage in a smaller witch hat with her open spellbook, wand, staff and closed book dropped, by scripts/pack-models.mjs; the bouquet, the garden, the butterflies and the petals are built in story.js). Stop 1: he tiptoes in with roses hidden behind his back and taps her shoulder; she jumps, her book flies off in a puff, he holds the bouquet out with a bow and a gift tag with the card's first words (slot note1) comes up. Stop 2: she steps up, takes it, smells it and cheers; flowers bloom across the card in a wave from her feet, butterflies rise and the card's photo comes up out of the flowers with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: they join hands and twirl round the middle while petals swirl up into a heart; they turn to the front hand in hand and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
